title: Flexible Counterfactual Explanations with Generative Models (FCEGAN)
summary: A framework for generating counterfactual explanations with user-defined mutable features at inference time, using GANs for black-box-compatible, high-quality counterfactual generation across finance, healthcare and HR datasets. Its data preprocessing pipeline imports RDT's ClusterBasedNormalizer and OneHotEncoder transformers to prepare tabular data for the GAN models.
needs: Only a single import site was surfaced; unclear how extensively RDT transformers are used elsewhere in the pipeline.
